invariants.rationale: The method collects file ids into a list and returns it; Collectors.toList() does not return null.
getFileId() should return a non-null file id for all file slices, so all returned ids in the list should be non-null.
The collection pipeline uses .distinct() before collecting, so result contains only unique values.
File ids are expected to be non-empty strings. Assuming getFileId() never returns empty strings.
partitionPath is used as an argument to getLatestFileSlices; null likely not allowed.
